title: Roles with LLM from the protocol (.a2dlc/roles.json, versioned)
description: Which command runs each role of §3 of the protocol and which family it belongs to. a2dlc run launches each role in its own --rm container, without a persistent HOME, with /in (read-only: request.json and the artifacts the core's policy lets it see), /out (empty, writable: it leaves response.json there) and, only for the builders, /work (writable copy of the tree). The role → visible artifacts policy is fixed in the binary (ADR meta/0004, amendment 2026-10-17): this file chooses image, command and family, but cannot widen mounts. A role that is absent leaves its stage skipped; the verdict says so. The core knows nothing of providers: the credential arrives through env_file, which the core passes to docker without using its values (it only reads the variable names). tier_up (CB-02b) is the same kind of configuration: the higher tier that Stage 3 tries once when a builder exhausts its rounds without a green Tier 0.

config.description: The shape of a role. No additionalProperties: whoever uses it closes it with unevaluatedProperties, so tier_up has the same shape and cannot have its own tier_up.

image.description: Image with the agent's CLI or the role's script. It is recorded with its digest in the ledger. It is an image reference and cannot start with "-": it goes as a positional argument of docker run, where a "--volume=..." would be read as a flag and would widen the mounts.

argv.description: Command inside the container. Receives A2DLC_REQUEST=/in/request.json and A2DLC_RESPONSE=/out/response.json; its output is validated against role-response.schema.json.

env_file.description: Local path (outside the repo) with the provider's credential, passed with --env-file. Each line is NAME=value, with NAME as in the ledger (^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$); a line that is not is rejected before launching the role. The core records the variable names, never the values.

env.description: Non-secret variables that the core passes with -e (e.g. A2DLC_LLM=gemini, A2DLC_MODEL). They are versioned with the file, so a credential goes in env_file, never here. The ledger records the names together with those of env_file; the values stay in the hash of the docker argv. It cannot overwrite the variables the core sets.

network.description: Egress of the role. none (default): no network, for deterministic script roles. provider: Docker network with egress only through the egress proxy, which enforces egress_allow (see README security model). An LLM role declares provider explicitly.

retries.description: Retries when the response does not validate against the schema or the command fails; each attempt stays in the ledger.

paradigm.description: Programming paradigm the role is asked to follow. Passed in the payload of the role; prompt-enforced, not verified.

egress_allow.description: Hostnames a provider role may reach through the egress proxy, which enforces this allowlist. Declare it for every backend other than openrouter or entropos; this schema does not check that rule.

tier_up.description: CB-02b: the role of a higher tier (same shape as a role, without its own tier_up). Stage 3 runs it once, with the round after the last one, when the builder exhausts max_inner_iterations without a green Tier 0.

additionalProperties.description: A role: its configuration, and optionally a builder's higher tier (tier_up, CB-02b).

family_exception.description: Written reason that allows two roles of the same family in this file. Absent: that is not allowed.
